QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_55

question.text: For cross-margining benefit between cash and derivatives segments, the positions must be:

answer.text: Offsetting positions held by the same client/entity across cash and derivatives segments - if the same clearing member clears both segments, client details are intimated through CIM; if different clearing members clear, they must enter into necessary agreements
In any securities as long as they are in different segments
Held by different clients of the same broker

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the source, cross-margining is available where offsetting client positions across cash and derivatives segments exist for the same client/entity. When the same clearing member clears both segments, client details are intimated through the Common Identification Mechanism (CIM); when different clearing members clear the two legs for the same client/entity, the clearing members must enter into the necessary agreements. The Trap: Same-clearing-member is not an absolute requirement - cross-margining is permitted across different clearing members provided the prescribed inter-CM agreements are in place. Note: Source: NISM-Series-VIII workbook (Dec 2025), page 165.
